# LIBERO (modified for ReSteer)

A trimmed, modified copy of [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) (Liu et al., NeurIPS 2023;
MIT license, see `LICENSE`). It contains what ReSteer runs: the LIBERO environment code and the LIBERO-Goal
steerability scene with its assets. The benchmark suites, initial states, other scenes' assets and the
lifelong-learning code are not included.

Every change relative to upstream, including the ones that affect task success, is listed in
[RESTEER_CHANGES.md](RESTEER_CHANGES.md). For the original benchmark, use upstream LIBERO.
